responsibility: Declares the interface for gm2 source preprocessing through an external C preprocessor. Its single exported routine takes a source filename and whether it is the main compilation unit, and returns either the original file or the pathname of a generated preprocessed temporary, providing the front-end contract between option handling and pre-parser source setup.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file only publishes the preprocessing interface—principally `PreprocessModule`—while the same-name `.mod` file contains the actual command-line construction, temporary-file naming, `system` invocation, and cleanup logic.
